items.title: 4304 Acoma Court Granbury, TX 76048
items.description: Picture yourself relaxing beneath majestic live oak trees, enjoying the park-like setting of approximately 2 acres in Indian Harbor. This inviting 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath home offers open living and dining areas where a wood-burning fireplace sets the scene for cozy evenings. Vinyl plank flooring flows throughout most of the home, while the bright and airy kitchen features beautiful granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a double oven, and a subway tile backsplash. Enjoy morning coffee in the heated and cooled sunroom, spend an afternoon on the patio with a view of Lake Granbury, or end the day with a relaxing soak in the hot tub. Multiple open patios offer space to gather or simply enjoy the surroundings. An attached 2 car garage, detached 2 car garage workshop, storage shed, and cellar provide room for hobbies, projects, and storage. The roof is just 2 years old. Keep the extra lots for added space or explore selling them separately if you don’t need the full acreage. Indian Harbor offers a 24-hour gated entrance, community marina with a boat ramp, swimming pool, tennis courts, playground, community center, teen center, and much more. Come imagine the life you could create here!
items.listingOffice: Tammy Dill of The Trusted Property Advisors

items.title: 4647 Lyndi Lane Granbury, TX 76049
items.description: Lake days, room for extended family, and a shop with space to get things done! Located on approximately one-third acre in Blue Water Shores near Lake Granbury, this manufactured home with additions offers approximately 1,464 square feet, two kitchens, and two living spaces. The flexible layout creates possibilities for multigenerational living or a mother-in-law arrangement, with room to gather and space to spread out. An oversized covered patio extends the living outdoors, perfect for morning coffee, weekend cookouts, or unwinding after a day on the lake. The 22x37 garage or shop offers generous space for hobbies, projects, tools, and storage, while a large detached carport provides additional covered parking. Enjoy an established lake area community with nearby opportunities for boating and fishing, plus access to Granbury’s historic square, local restaurants, boutiques, and entertainment. Bring your vision and personal touches to make this versatile property your own
items.listingOffice: Heidi Mayer of 6th Ave Homes

items.title: 9508 Nutcracker Court Granbury, TX 76049
items.description: Turnkey Golf Course Living – Luxury, Views, and Unmatched Amenities! Welcome to your front-row seat to the best sunsets in Granbury! Overlooking the Nutcracker Golf Course pond, this spacious Pecan Plantation garden home offers a lifestyle of comfort and sophistication. Step through the front door to find an expansive open-concept layout—truly a host’s dream. Living area features warm, wood floors and a handsome fireplace. The chef-inspired kitchen is a showstopper, boasting exotic Brazilian Rainforest Portifino countertops and a layout that makes entertaining family a breeze. A massive wrap-around porch and low-maintenance landscaping with full irrigation allows more time for recreation. Other notable features include sturdy, steel-framed construction and high-efficiency windows installed in 2016. Roof replaced and house painted in June 2024. All this plus 24-7 EMS and top-tier VFD services within the community. From the marina and campgrounds to the dog park and swimming pools, Pecan Plantation is more than a neighborhood—it’s a destination. Don’t miss your chance to own a piece of this unique golfing paradise! Located just minutes from historic downtown Granbury and a short hour from Fort Worth.
items.listingOffice: Lana Robinson of Prairie Wind Real Estate

items.title: 3904 Country Meadows Road Granbury, TX
items.description: Charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath home with a spacious open layout and an oversized backyard. The bright living area features vaulted ceilings, wood-look flooring, and an easy flow into the dining and kitchen spaces. The kitchen offers generous counter space, stainless appliances, and a breakfast bar overlooking the main living area. The primary suite is nicely sized with a private bath, while two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, an office, or family use. Outside, the large fenced backyard offers plenty of room for pets, play, entertaining, gardening, or future outdoor improvements. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and entertainment, with easy access to DFW.
items.listingOffice: Natalie Self of Elevate Realty Group

items.title: 157 Ponce De Leon Road Granbury, TX 76048
items.description: NEW! NEVER LIVED IN. Ready December 2026! Bloomfield Homes’ Dogwood is a one-story plan with 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, a study, and a 2-car garage. Upgraded brick and mortar, cedar garage doors, a covered front porch, an 8' front door, and exterior lighting give this home a striking first impression. Beyond the foyer, glass doors define the front study, while wood floors continue through the entry, kitchen, breakfast nook, family room, and hallways. The kitchen brings its details together around a quartz-topped island with a single-bowl sink and 2 pendant lights. White cabinetry, an upgraded backsplash, and under-cabinet lighting finish the surrounding work area. Beside it, the breakfast nook opens to a family room lined with windows along the side and rear walls. The primary bedroom sits toward the back of the plan, separate from the 2 secondary bedrooms, and connects to a walk-in closet and bath with upgraded countertops. Its enlarged shower gets special attention: upgraded tile on the walls and floor, an accent tile detail, and a second shower head. The secondary bath has upgraded tile on the tub surround and floor, plus its own accent tile. Window seats add character, and 2 inch blinds are already in place throughout. Upgraded carpet and utility room tile bring the same attention to the practical spaces. A covered patio opens to the interior lot, and El Dorado’s playground offers another place to gather nearby. Visit Bloomfield Homes’ model in El Dorado to see this Dogwood in person today!
items.listingOffice: Marsha Ashlock of Visions Realty & Investments

items.title: 3205 Windcrest Drive Granbury, TX
items.description: Newer construction on the Ft Worth side of town in Acton close to post office. Open floorpan with upgraded tile floors, Granite countertops, stainless steel appliances. Trane HVAC. Full sod and sprinkler system with wood privacy fence.
items.listingOffice: Brian Blevins of Elevate Realty Group

items.title: 113 W Arnold Street Granbury, TX 76048
items.description: Don't Delay. Charming and cozy home, ideally located just minutes away from Granbury's Historic Downtown Square. This delightful home has been thoughtfully updated, boasting modernized features such as new flooring, kitchen appliances, stylish butcher block counters, and an inviting bathroom. With three bedrooms, this home offers versatility; one bedroom could easily be transformed into a home office, library, or study, perfect for those who work from home or enjoy reading. The welcoming layout and inviting interiors make it suitable for a variety of lifestyles, whether you are a first-time homebuyer or an investor seeking a rental property, the possibilities are endless. The home sits on a manageable small lot, ensuring that maintenance is a breeze, allowing you more time to enjoy your surroundings. The one-car carport provides added convenience and protection for your vehicle. Situated just north of the square, this home places you within easy reach of the vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment options that Granbury has to offer. From quaint boutiques to delightful cafes and lively events, life in this area is rich with culture and opportunity. Don’t miss out on the chance to make this updated home your own, whether as a new place to call home or as a savvy investment property that promises potential returns. Experience the best of Granbury here!
items.listingOffice: Pam Knieper of Knieper Realty, Inc

items.title: 700 Aqua Vista Drive Granbury, TX
items.description: This home is a typical style Hill Country home, custom build in 1986. Lake view, no HOA. Large Lot fully fenced in Western Red Cedar with concrete Footing, and double gate. Lot size is 22,600 Sq ft. Downstairs living space has wooden Plantation Shutters and a wood burning Fireplace. There are 3 bedrooms upstairs, and two full baths. Downstairs are one bedroom with full bath and closet connecting, plus a half bath off entry hall. All Porcelain tile flooring downstairs, all solid Oak flooring all upstairs with exception of Both baths which are tiled. Carpet on stairs, rock Patio off dining room. All new replacement windows by Clarity Windows 2015 with Lifetime warranty which rolls over to new owner. New HVAC system in 2024. New hot water heater 2022. Large storage Shed in backyard with new concrete flooring 2026.
items.listingOffice: Jonathan Minerick of HomeCoin.com

items.title: 2105 Wood Duck Lane Granbury, TX
items.description: Jump on the rare opportunity to own a newly renovated 4-bedroom, 2.5 bath forever home on a 1.16-acre lot in prestigious Mallard Pointe Estates. Relax in the spacious living room where a stunning propane fireplace and rustic custom mantel create a warm welcoming atmosphere for cozy nights in or entertaining. The open-concept floor plan’s living room flows to the breakfast area and large kitchen featuring granite counter tops, stainless-steel appliances, double ovens, built-in microwave, propane cooktop, walk-in pantry, and convenient island. Retreat to the primary bedroom with two large closets and ensuite master bathroom with dual vanities, walk-in shower, and a garden tub to unwind. The 3 additional bedrooms are well-sized with 2 sharing a bathroom between. The enclosed back porch has ceiling fans, natural light, and is perfect for morning coffee, romantic dinners, or watching deer emerge from the woods. The oversized backyard is a blank slate ready for gardens, a luxury pool, or perhaps a workshop or car barn. The 3-car garage features a permanent staircase to a floored attic, epoxy floors, and insulated garage doors - perfect for tinkering or storing fun toys or collector cars. Enjoy reduced water bill as the sprinkler system leverages your own private well. Enjoy the convenience of docking your watercraft in a deeded slip at the newly renovated and well-secured marina adjacent to the boat ramp and private waterfront park and playground. Mallard Pointe Estates is a very friendly and well-maintained neighborhood with large lots lending a spacious country feel but it’s just minutes from major stores and the historic small town square featuring many eclectic shops, fine or fun dining, and quality entertainment options. Even better, you will be on the north side of Granbury which makes it an easy drive to nearby Fort Worth for bigger venues, shopping malls, and more. Schedule your private showing today as homes in this exclusive enclave don’t last long!
items.listingOffice: Michelle Grothouse of TRU Land & Homes

items.title: 6343 Weatherby Road Granbury, TX 76049
items.description: Exceptional Custom Home in Pecan Plantation. Thoughtful design, 200K in extensive upgrades & quality finishes come together beautifully. Circular drive & striking entry, real hardwood floors, solid core doors & designer lighting, beyond standard finishes. Open living area features coffered ceiling, custom built ins with granite tops, floor to ceiling fireplace tile & 4 panel sliding door that opens living space to outdoor entertaining area. Kitchen is showpiece with Super White granite countertops & backsplash, custom staingrade cabinetry, lighted upper cabinets, soft close doors &drawers, Kohler chef's sink, Thermador appliance package including 6 burner rangetop, double oven with steam oven, warming drawer & dishwasher. Ajoining butler's pantry adds extensive cabinetry, second dishwasher, drawer microwave, oversized sink, custom spice storage, reverse osmosis system & space for an additional refrigerator or freezer. Private primary suite offers patio access, custom remote window treatment & separate his & her closets with built-in dressers & extensive storage. Spa inspired bath features split vanities, garden tub, oversized shower, dual shower heads & seating, marble-style tile & separate water closet with bidet. Addt'l spaces include office, oversized dining room, guest rooms, with full bath, laundry room & mudroom. Outdoor living is equally impressive with a large covered patio featuring 4 remote controlled motorized screens, stained beadboard ceiling, brick perimeter seating, ceiling fans & plumbed for gas. All overlooking water feature. Oversized 3 car garage designed to accommodate full size SUVs & includes 9FT doors, attic lift, insulated doors, stainless utility sink, 240V electric car outlet & Survive-A-Storm tornado shelter. Additional upgrades include a TEK metal roof, 22 SEER variable-speed HVAC, spray foam encapsulation, 500 gallon buried propane tank, upgraded electrical panels, plantation shutters, 9 zone sprinkler system & TifTuf Bermuda grass.
items.listingOffice: Rebecca Van Buren of Keller Williams Brazos West

items.title: 5703 N Sunchase Drive Granbury, TX 76049
items.description: Welcome home to 5703 N Sunchase Dr where you'll get country living and convenience! This well maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom single wide home sits on a manicured and spacious .49 acre lot that offers that feel of county life that you've been looking for. With an open floor plan and functional living space, comfortability is not lacking here. Enjoy no carpet throughout, an R-panel roof, water softener system, aerobic septic system and a large outdoor shed with electricity. The large front porch is perfect for your morning cup of coffee or enjoying the sunset. The convenient circular drive offers plenty of space for parking and easy access to the carport which provides additional covered parking. Enjoy the peace and privacy of country living while being just 15 minutes from Downtown Granbury, where shopping, dining, entertainment, and Lake Granbury await. A great opportunity to enjoy more space and a relaxed lifestyle without being far from town!
items.listingOffice: Kelly Snodgrass of HomeSmart

items.title: 4101 Newport Bay Court Granbury, TX
items.description: LOOKING FOR LOVE… I THINK YOU JUST FOUND IT IN GRANBURY! Dear Future Homeowner, I’ve been waiting for you. Tucked away on a quiet court in Granbury, I’m a waterfront home where life moves a little slower, sunsets seem brighter, and lake life can be part of every day. I offer 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, beautiful updates, and an amazing updated sunroom made for enjoying the view in every season. Step outside to mature trees, a nice-sized yard, your own boat dock, and a seawall that was repaired and updated in 2026. Imagine starting your morning with coffee on the patio while the water is peaceful. Spend the afternoon boating on Lake Granbury, fishing from your dock, or cruising across the lake for dinner. When evening comes, pour your favorite drink, relax on the patio, and watch the Texas sunset. Ready to explore? Head to Granbury’s Historic Square for shopping, restaurants, live entertainment, festivals, and small-town fun. Then come home to your own waterfront retreat. I’m ready for cookouts, celebrations, family gatherings, quiet mornings, lake adventures, and memories that last a lifetime. And before you fall completely in love, there’s one more reason to take a closer look: an assumable loan with an attractive interest rate may be available to qualified buyers. If you’ve been searching for waterfront living, Granbury charm, and a place that feels like home… Maybe I’m the one you’ve been looking for.
items.listingOffice: Lisa Randolph of Cattell Real Estate Group

Lot size is 22,600 Sq ft. Downstairs living space has wooden Plantation Shutters and a wood burning Fireplace. There are 3 bedrooms upstairs, and two full baths. Downstairs are one bedroom with full bath and closet connecting, plus a half bath off entry hall. All Porcelain tile flooring downstairs, all solid Oak flooring all upstairs with exception of Both baths which are tiled. Carpet on stairs, rock Patio off dining room. All new replacement windows by Clarity Windows 2015 with Lifetime warranty which rolls over to new owner. New HVAC system in 2024. New hot water heater 2022. Large storage Shed in backyard with new concrete flooring 2026.
items.listingOffice: Jonathan Minerick of HomeCoin.com

items.title: 2105 Wood Duck Lane Granbury, TX
items.description: Jump on the rare opportunity to own a newly renovated 4-bedroom, 2.5 bath forever home on a 1.16-acre lot in prestigious Mallard Pointe Estates. Relax in the spacious living room where a stunning propane fireplace and rustic custom mantel create a warm welcoming atmosphere for cozy nights in or entertaining. The open-concept floor plan’s living room flows to the breakfast area and large kitchen featuring granite counter tops, stainless-steel appliances, double ovens, built-in microwave, propane cooktop, walk-in pantry, and convenient island. Retreat to the primary bedroom with two large closets and ensuite master bathroom with dual vanities, walk-in shower, and a garden tub to unwind. The 3 additional bedrooms are well-sized with 2 sharing a bathroom between. The enclosed back porch has ceiling fans, natural light, and is perfect for morning coffee, romantic dinners, or watching deer emerge from the woods. The oversized backyard is a blank slate ready for gardens, a luxury pool, or perhaps a workshop or car barn. The 3-car garage features a permanent staircase to a floored attic, epoxy floors, and insulated garage doors - perfect for tinkering or storing fun toys or collector cars. Enjoy reduced water bill as the sprinkler system leverages your own private well. Enjoy the convenience of docking your watercraft in a deeded slip at the newly renovated and well-secured marina adjacent to the boat ramp and private waterfront park and playground. Mallard Pointe Estates is a very friendly and well-maintained neighborhood with large lots lending a spacious country feel but it’s just minutes from major stores and the historic small town square featuring many eclectic shops, fine or fun dining, and quality entertainment options. Even better, you will be on the north side of Granbury which makes it an easy drive to nearby Fort Worth for bigger venues, shopping malls, and more. Schedule your private showing today as homes in this exclusive enclave don’t last long!
items.listingOffice: Michelle Grothouse of TRU Land & Homes

items.title: 6343 Weatherby Road Granbury, TX 76049
items.description: Exceptional Custom Home in Pecan Plantation. Thoughtful design, 200K in extensive upgrades & quality finishes come together beautifully. Circular drive & striking entry, real hardwood floors, solid core doors & designer lighting, beyond standard finishes. Open living area features coffered ceiling, custom built ins with granite tops, floor to ceiling fireplace tile & 4 panel sliding door that opens living space to outdoor entertaining area. Kitchen is showpiece with Super White granite countertops & backsplash, custom staingrade cabinetry, lighted upper cabinets, soft close doors &drawers, Kohler chef's sink, Thermador appliance package including 6 burner rangetop, double oven with steam oven, warming drawer & dishwasher. Ajoining butler's pantry adds extensive cabinetry, second dishwasher, drawer microwave, oversized sink, custom spice storage, reverse osmosis system & space for an additional refrigerator or freezer. Private primary suite offers patio access, custom remote window treatment & separate his & her closets with built-in dressers & extensive storage. Spa inspired bath features split vanities, garden tub, oversized shower, dual shower heads & seating, marble-style tile & separate water closet with bidet. Addt'l spaces include office, oversized dining room, guest rooms, with full bath, laundry room & mudroom. Outdoor living is equally impressive with a large covered patio featuring 4 remote controlled motorized screens, stained beadboard ceiling, brick perimeter seating, ceiling fans & plumbed for gas. All overlooking water feature. Oversized 3 car garage designed to accommodate full size SUVs & includes 9FT doors, attic lift, insulated doors, stainless utility sink, 240V electric car outlet & Survive-A-Storm tornado shelter. Additional upgrades include a TEK metal roof, 22 SEER variable-speed HVAC, spray foam encapsulation, 500 gallon buried propane tank, upgraded electrical panels, plantation shutters, 9 zone sprinkler system & TifTuf Bermuda grass.
items.listingOffice: Rebecca Van Buren of Keller Williams Brazos West

items.title: 5703 N Sunchase Drive Granbury, TX 76049
items.description: Welcome home to 5703 N Sunchase Dr where you'll get country living and convenience! This well maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom single wide home sits on a manicured and spacious .49 acre lot that offers that feel of county life that you've been looking for. With an open floor plan and functional living space, comfortability is not lacking here. Enjoy no carpet throughout, an R-panel roof, water softener system, aerobic septic system and a large outdoor shed with electricity. The large front porch is perfect for your morning cup of coffee or enjoying the sunset. The convenient circular drive offers plenty of space for parking and easy access to the carport which provides additional covered parking. Enjoy the peace and privacy of country living while being just 15 minutes from Downtown Granbury, where shopping, dining, entertainment, and Lake Granbury await. A great opportunity to enjoy more space and a relaxed lifestyle without being far from town!
items.listingOffice: Kelly Snodgrass of HomeSmart

items.title: 4101 Newport Bay Court Granbury, TX
items.description: LOOKING FOR LOVE… I THINK YOU JUST FOUND IT IN GRANBURY! Dear Future Homeowner, I’ve been waiting for you. Tucked away on a quiet court in Granbury, I’m a waterfront home where life moves a little slower, sunsets seem brighter, and lake life can be part of every day. I offer 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, beautiful updates, and an amazing updated sunroom made for enjoying the view in every season. Step outside to mature trees, a nice-sized yard, your own boat dock, and a seawall that was repaired and updated in 2026. Imagine starting your morning with coffee on the patio while the water is peaceful. Spend the afternoon boating on Lake Granbury, fishing from your dock, or cruising across the lake for dinner. When evening comes, pour your favorite drink, relax on the patio, and watch the Texas sunset. Ready to explore? Head to Granbury’s Historic Square for shopping, restaurants, live entertainment, festivals, and small-town fun. Then come home to your own waterfront retreat. I’m ready for cookouts, celebrations, family gatherings, quiet mornings, lake adventures, and memories that last a lifetime. And before you fall completely in love, there’s one more reason to take a closer look: an assumable loan with an attractive interest rate may be available to qualified buyers. If you’ve been searching for waterfront living, Granbury charm, and a place that feels like home… Maybe I’m the one you’ve been looking for.
items.listingOffice: Lisa Randolph of Cattell Real Estate Group
